gloss: all talk; lip service; empty words

definitions.gloss: all talk; lip service; empty words
definitions.explanation: Describes someone who says things they don't mean or makes promises they won't keep. The words are superficial, coming only from the lips without genuine feeling or intent to act.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの{人|ひと}→あの人：25922_anohito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{口先|くちさき}だけだ。
{口先|くちさき}だけ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{謝罪|しゃざい}→謝罪：06754_shazai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{許|ゆる}せない→許す：02325_yurusu⟧。
examples.english: I can't forgive an apology that's just lip service.

examples.japanese: {口先|くちさき}だけ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{約束|やくそく}→約束：01517_yakusoku⟧⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧、⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{示|しめ}して→示す：01948_shimesu⟧ほしい。
examples.english: I want you to show it through actions, not just empty promises.

notes:
⟦{口先|くちさき}→口先：16728_kuchisaki⟧ literally means "the tip of the mouth" — the idea is that the words come only from the surface, without engaging the heart or the will to follow through. Always carries a negative, critical nuance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {口先|くちさき}だけ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{約束|やくそく}→約束：01517_yakusoku⟧: empty promise
- {口先|くちさき}だけ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{謝罪|しゃざい}→謝罪：06754_shazai⟧: insincere apology
- {口先|くちさき}だけ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{優|やさ}しさ: superficial kindness
- {口先|くちさき}だけ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: person who is all talk

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧: all mouth — very similar meaning, slightly more casual
- {有言不実行|ゆうげんふじっこう}: saying but not doing — a four-character compound with a more formal tone
- {空約束|からやくそく}: empty promise — focuses specifically on promises not kept
